steps.title: Keep orders from the start of the quarter
steps.change: The first day belongs to the quarter. Orders is the only source because each output row is an order, and OrderDate determines eligibility while OrderID and amount are already present.
steps.added_sql:
select OrderID, CustomerID, OrderDate,Total_Order_Amount
from Orders
where OrderDate>= '2025-01-01'
order by OrderDate asc , OrderID asc
steps.sql:
select OrderID, CustomerID, OrderDate,Total_Order_Amount
from Orders
where OrderDate>= '2025-01-01'
order by OrderDate asc , OrderID asc

steps.title: Exclude the start of the next quarter
steps.change: The next quarter is excluded while all March 31 timestamps remain eligible.
